name: @btkulka/runpod-client
description: Rent a GPU by the minute on RunPod for Ben's apps: the REST API v2 (the GPU catalog with prices, pods: create, read, logs, run a command, stop, terminate), and a guarded rental on top: pick the cheapest GPU with enough memory, a cost estimate before anything is spent, a budget cap, a hard deadline enforced by a detached watchdog that terminates the pod even if the caller dies, a sweep for strays, and the pod's HTTPS proxy address. The key from Benhäus Credentials (env RUNPOD_API_KEY as the fallback). btkulka-runpod from a terminal. Node only; ESM and CommonJS.

hints.message: RunPod doesn't know this key. Make one in RunPod › Settings › API Keys (read and write, so it can start and stop pods) and paste it again.
The key can't read the account: give it read and write access to pods in RunPod › Settings › API Keys.
